prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pour the colored silicone mixture from the test tube into the mold at the center of tray.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: tray
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold at the center of tray contains uniformly mixed silicone mixture.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A close, angled view down into a white square tray or containment basin with raised walls, set on a workbench. The tray's flat white floor carries several small metal screws/dome-headed fasteners near its corners and edges.

Resting centrally on the tray floor is a white rectangular block or plate with a grid of small square wells or recesses on its upper face. Several wells and the surrounding surface are stained or wetted with teal-green liquid, pooled most heavily near the middle of the block.

A printed black-and-white fiducial marker tag sits on the bench at upper left, another marker at lower left. White structural posts with metal bolts stand at the top left and top right. Grey floor visible behind.
observations: The mold contains teal-green liquid pooled near the center, but the description does not confirm if the mixture is uniformly mixed or if it is properly contained within the wells.

args.observations: The mold contains teal-green liquid pooled near the center, but the description does not confirm if the mixture is uniformly mixed or if it is properly contained within the wells.
